description: Check whether a Shopify store's storefront tracking pixel is installed and reporting to this account. Read live from Shopify on every call, because a merchant can remove the pixel without Sequenzy hearing about it. Check this before telling the user that browse abandonment, cart recovery, product views, collection views, or storefront search will work: without a live pixel those events never arrive, the sequences built on them never fire, and nothing anywhere reports an error. Returns `pixel.healthy`, the endpoint and signed configuration state, and `dependentEvents` - the event names that rely on this pixel. When `pixel.error` is null and `pixel.healthy` is false, those events are confirmed dark; an error means Shopify could not confirm their state. Fix a confirmed unhealthy state with activate_integration_pixel. Shopify only; other providers return a clear error.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

integrationId.description: Shopify integration ID from list_integrations or get_integration.

name: get_integration_pixel

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_integration_pixel` MCP tool.

dependentEvents.description: Event names that depend on this pixel. They are confirmed unable to arrive only when pixel.error is null and pixel.healthy is false.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

pixel.description: Live pixel state: installed, id, endpoint it posts to, endpointCurrent (including the supported compatibility route), configurationCurrent (endpoint plus signed connection settings), healthy, and error when Shopify could not confirm.

shopDomain.description: Store the pixel was read from.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
